_comment: Hand-written mood data keyed by Met objectID. fetch-met.mjs merges this with live metadata from the Met Collection API into src/data/paintings.json. Axes run -1..1: energy (+restless / -calm), warmth (+warm / -cool), outlook (+hopeful / -heavy), focus (+inward / -outward).

436535.why: Your mind has been racing, but you're drawn to warm light and looking ahead. Van Gogh painted a restless, swirling sky over a calm golden field.

435809.why: You wanted somewhere unhurried and warm. Bruegel's harvesters eat, nap and work under a hazy late-summer sky, and nobody is in a rush.

437869.why: You've been holding yourself together with quiet dignity. Velázquez painted his assistant looking straight back at you with exactly that.

437881.why: You're after a clear, quiet moment. Vermeer caught one: cool morning light, an open window, and nothing that needs doing yet.

436105.why: Something is weighing on you and you're meeting it head-on. David's Socrates keeps talking, calm and certain, as he reaches for the cup.

438815.why: You're after warmth and company more than quiet. Renoir painted a mother, two children and a very patient dog settling into a long afternoon at home.

436947.why: You're feeling bright and ready to be out in the world. Manet's Boating is all sun, blue water and an easy afternoon with someone else at the tiller.

438817.why: Your energy is up and scattered in a good way. Degas's dancers stretch, fidget and wait their turn in a room full of small motions.

436528.why: You're quieter than usual and hoping for something gentle. Van Gogh painted these irises in his last spring, and they are nothing but colour and care.

11417.why: You've got momentum and you're pointed at something. Leutze's river crossing is all forward motion against the ice.

10481.why: You wanted room to breathe. Church painted an entire continent of light and distance into one frame.

10497.why: You're somewhere between a storm and a clearing, and you know it. Cole put both in the same sky and stood right in the middle.

12127.why: You're keeping your cool and a little distance. Sargent's Madame X turns away from the room and lets it look.
